purpose: Source-grounded worked case; no operational runtime or workload-distribution claim
edge_rule: Unit undirected edge if either package declares the other as a runtime dependency; ignore external packages; keep isolates
old_unary_rule: Sorted package index alternates synthetic preferred team; cost 0 on preference and 4 on alternative; exact old mincut supplies x0
capacity_gate: Pass example reserves L0 + exact worst incoming budget load; fail example reduces one positive worst incoming allowance by one. Both are hypothetical reservations.
worked_case_selection: First case in sorted anchor, increase, budget order with a budget-infeasible unconstrained cut, proper region and strict improvement over x0. Illustrative selection only; retain all 64 cases.
timing: No performance conclusion; enumerate every binary assignment as an independent correctness oracle
